skill.summary: Search B2B leads and companies, find/validate emails via Generect Live API. Use when the user needs to find people by job title/company/industry, search companies by ICP, generate business emails from name+domain, or validate email addresses. Covers lead generation, prospecting, enrichment, and email discovery workflows.
